result.title: MuCHMDPoser: Multiview RGB-Camera Full-Body Pose Tracking for Virtual Reality
result.summary: Accurate full-body tracking in Virtual Reality (VR) is heavily underconstrained when relying solely on consumer-grade sparse sensors, such as Head-Mounted Displays (HMDs) and handheld controllers. Indeed, the self-avatar full-body pose must be inferred based on the 3 available upper-body joints tracked by these devices. This leads to significant tracking error, especially in lower-body pose. To overcome this issue, we propose to extend the tracking setup with external multiview RGB cameras. We show that integrating RGB-based pose estimation this framework is able to significantly decrease lower-body tracking errors, even under common artifacts in RGB-based estimates. Additionally, we evaluate a only-once HMD-camera calibration procedure that does not require any physical markers. We finally propose an implementation of the overall framework, achieving an end-to-end animation at 60 FPS on a Nvidia RTX3080 GPU. Codes are available at https://github.com/antmaio/MuCHMDPoser.

AI.brief_summary: 该工作为 VR 场景下的全身姿态跟踪，用多视角 RGB 相机估计弥补仅靠头显与手柄 3 个上身关节造成的下肢欠约束，并给出免标记标定流程与 60 FPS 实时实现。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于动作捕捉与虚拟形象动画的应用系统，虽涉及多源传感器信息融合，但未触及 latent 视觉推理的状态表示、证据筛选或停止决策，缺少可供核查的具体借鉴线索。
